✨ 杰出的终极升级者 | Img2Img + LoRA 支持

使用专为高质量 Img2Img 升级和细化而设计的 ComfyUI 工作流程，同时保持完全的 LoRA 兼容性，将您的辉煌一代提升到一个新的水平。

无论您是处理肖像、人物、插图还是高度详细的动画艺术品，此工作流程都有助于恢复精细细节、提高整体图像质量并增强视觉一致性，而无需牺牲原始构图。

特点

✅ 基于 Img2Img 的升级和细化
✅ 全面的 LoRA 支持
✅ 保留角色身份和风格
✅ 改善细节、纹理和清晰度
✅ 非常适合动漫、插图和角色艺术
✅ 针对不同高档优势的灵活设置
✅ 易于定制和扩展

推荐用例

  • 增强低分辨率世代

  • 完善现有的杰出成果

  • 在最终升级之前添加额外的细节

  • 改善面部特征和服装细节

  • 准备图像以供共享、打印或进一步编辑

温馨提示

  • 较低的噪点值有助于保留原始图像。

  • 更高的噪点值可以实现更强的细化和细节生成。

  • 尝试不同的 LoRA 以实现独特的艺术风格。

  • 为了获得最佳结果，请从相当干净的源图像开始。

兼容于

  • 著名的检查站

  • 角色 LoRA

  • LoRA 风格

  • 详细 LoRA

  • 最标准的 ComfyUI 安装

注释

此工作流程旨在实现细节增强、图像稳定性和 LoRA 灵活性之间的平衡。结果可能会有所不同，具体取决于检查点、LoRA、提示和源图像质量。

如果您发现它有用，请考虑留下评分并分享您的结果。看到其他人使用工作流程创建的内容总是令人赞赏。 🚀

版本：初始版本

洛拉支持：是的 ✅

✨ Illustrious Ultimate Upscaler | Img2Img + LoRA Support

Take your Illustrious generations to the next level with this ComfyUI workflow designed for high-quality Img2Img upscaling and refinement while maintaining full LoRA compatibility.

Whether you're working with portraits, characters, illustrations, or highly detailed anime artwork, this workflow helps recover fine details, improve overall image quality, and enhance visual consistency without sacrificing the original composition.

Features

✅ Img2Img-based upscaling and refinement
✅ Full LoRA support
✅ Preserves character identity and style
✅ Improves details, textures, and sharpness
✅ Great for anime, illustrations, and character art
✅ Flexible settings for different upscale strengths
✅ Easy to customize and expand

Recommended Use Cases

  • Enhancing low-resolution generations

  • Refining existing Illustrious outputs

  • Adding extra detail before final upscaling

  • Improving facial features and clothing details

  • Preparing images for sharing, printing, or further editing

Tips

  • Lower denoise values help preserve the original image.

  • Higher denoise values allow for stronger refinement and detail generation.

  • Experiment with different LoRAs to achieve unique artistic styles.

  • For best results, start with a reasonably clean source image.

Compatible With

  • Illustrious-based checkpoints

  • Character LoRAs

  • Style LoRAs

  • Detail LoRAs

  • Most standard ComfyUI installations

Notes

This workflow was built to provide a balance between detail enhancement, image stability, and LoRA flexibility. Results may vary depending on the checkpoint, LoRAs, prompts, and source image quality.

If you find it useful, consider leaving a rating and sharing your results. Seeing what others create with the workflow is always appreciated. 🚀

Version:Initial Release
Workflow Type:ComfyUI Img2Img Upscaler
Model Family:Illustrious
LoRA Support:Yes ✅
